description:
## Goal

Remove the latent-executable channel from activation analysis because it has no producer and can only publish empty collections. Correct semantic-fixpoint documentation so executable ownership matches the live root/product path.

## Proof at a3a9761d1

Every leaf `CallEmission` constructor initializes `latent_executables` with `Vec::new()`. Merge and rebuild paths only concatenate values originating from those constructors. Therefore:

- the activation publication loop can never emit `FactKey::Executable`;
- `ActivationAnalysis::latent_executables` is always empty;
- activation dumps can never render a latent-executables section;
- JSONL telemetry always reports zero;
- test constructors carry meaningless empty scaffolding.

Executable discovery already comes from the real ownership paths: roots seed their entry executable, while demanded products discover further executables through settled call edges and callable entries.

## Change

- Delete `CallEmission::latent_executables` and all initializer, merge, and rebuild plumbing.
- Delete the unreachable executable-publication loop.
- Delete `ActivationAnalysis::latent_executables`.
- Delete dump, telemetry, and test handling for the field.
- Delete dump helpers orphaned by removing the empty section.
- Update `.agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md`: remove `Executable(callee_key, need)` from `AnalyzeActivation` outputs and replace the false ownership claim with the actual root/product path.
- Add no compatibility field or adapter.

## Signal and checks

- Repository search finds no `latent_executables` or orphaned dump helper.
- Documentation no longer claims that `AnalyzeActivation` publishes executable facts.
- Existing root/executable inventory tests prove executable discovery is unchanged.
- Focused activation-analysis, executable-inventory, dump, and JSONL tests pass.
- Full library, CLI, single-threaded fixture matrix, workspace checks, formatting, and strict clippy pass.
title: Delete the always-empty latent-executable channel and correct its documented ownership
